_readme: MANAS for Windows Terminal, matching kitty's manas-theme.conf on the Arch desktop.
Merge by hand into Windows Terminal's settings.json (Settings > Open JSON file):
- add the object in "schemes" to settings.json's "schemes" list
- add the object in "themes" to settings.json's "themes" list
- set the top-level "theme" to "MANAS" (colours the tab row and title bar)
- copy the keys in "archProfile" into the Arch Linux entry under profiles.list
backgroundImage must be a Windows path: copy kitty/.config/kitty/dog-manas.png to the
Windows side first, because Windows Terminal cannot read \\wsl$ paths reliably.
Opacity 0.34 matches kitty's background_tint 0.66. Unlike kitty, Windows Terminal can
anchor the picture, so bottomRight keeps the puppy in view at any window shape.
